pr_title: Added validator for extra profile field values with empty name
pr_body:
Fixes #33201

This PR adds a validator to check if any of the extra fields provided in a profile update have a value but an empty name, and applies that validator on the account model so that unapplied invalid fields don't result in the success message.

issue_context.title: Success message after failing to save keyless profile field
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce the problem

1. Go to edit profile
2. Enter a `content` value but leave the `label` blank
3. Hit "Save"


### Expected behaviour

Should get some indication that conent cannot be saved without a label.

### Actual behaviour

Message "Changes successfully saved!", but newly entered content vanished.

### Detailed description

_No response_

### Mastodon instance

mastodon.social

### Mastodon version

v4.3.0 (actually not sure, there was no information at the bottom of the About page)

### Browser name and version

Firefox 133.0

### Operating system

macOS 15

_No response_
comments:
Confirmed this.

I suspect the "fields" are correctly not saving themselves w/ missing data, but thats not bubbling up to a validation error on the record being saved. Need to investigate more.

I have confirmed while working on this that @mjankowski 's thinking is correct about the fields in question not being saved. The current behavior is that the front-end sends in the full set of fields, empty or not, and any fields where the name is empty are simply skipped during processing. That behavior is here: https://github.com/timothyjrogers/mastodon/blob/main/app/models/account.rb#L303.

I have submitted a PR (https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/actions/runs/12572277503/job/35044094141?pr=33421) modifying that behavior to only skip records where both name and value are empty, as well as adding a validator to catch records that have a value but no name.

Unfortunately I was not able to figure out how to get a good front-end error to show up when the validator fires. For example if you tweak the page to allow a too-long display name it'll highlight the field red and give you a message beneath -- I wasn't able to get that to work for the extra-fields input. The change I've submitted will just create the generic `Something isn't quite right yet! Please review the error below` which is the same behavior you get if you trick the page into letting you submit a too-long extra field so it's at least consistent.

review_comments: Should add at least 1-2 new examples to model spec showing the changing validation behaviour here, and optionally a request spec showing the changing response json (and http code, if it does change) around the scenario we are modifying here.

Thanks for pointing that out, completely forgot about the specs. I have added examples in the account model spec for too many fields, fields with values but no names, and the valid name but no value scenario. As for the request I don't believe that behavior has changed, if you submit a no-name field you still get back a 200 because the error is just rendered in the page.
